scientific_exceptions.phase_minimum: min_epochs=15 reaches the latest zero-based epoch10 phase; it is a common budget, not a promise of convergence or original-paper accuracy
scientific_exceptions.nongradient_classical: Classical calibration/regression uses its actual scientific algorithm; no fictitious AdamW updates or optimizer epochs
scientific_exceptions.dimension_protocol: Canonical data retain XYZ; real XYZ predictions have same-prediction XY metrics; original 2D profiles remain a separate XY reference protocol; missing predicted Z is never filled
scientific_exceptions.reference_permission: Reference attitude or initial state stays in a declared reference/oracle track; reference inputs do not become deployable device sensors
scientific_exceptions.unsupported_reason: Required device imu/orientation is absent in at least one declared primary/extra evaluation split; retain all48 coverage cells with the reason instead of substituting reference quaternion
scientific_exceptions.robot_transfer: RIDI human-to-robot transfer is a cross-domain diagnostic, outside the human in-domain training leaderboard
scientific_exceptions.model_selection: Use train/validation for fitting and selection; no test tuning
scientific_exceptions.labels_and_source_scope: Acquired versions/subsets only; reference system fidelity and group overlap warnings remain source-specific; mixed-source repackaging and duplicate views do not increase independent counts
scientific_exceptions.predictions: Main full-matrix cells save_predictions=false; controlled shrinkage replay artifacts use a separate bounded diagnostic protocol

reproduction_boundary: This public record is a scientific protocol, not private operational state. Source/data/CPU/capacity admission must be independently established on another installation; formal results are still being produced.
